output.title: Breaking change to HTTP01 ACME challenge Ingress PathType
output.content: This is a breaking change that modifies HTTP01 ACME challenge paths to use PathType `Exact` in Ingress routes. If cert-manager HTTP01 challenges are configured in this environment, this change improves security and standards compliance but may affect Ingress controllers that don't support `Exact` PathType. Review your ACME challenge configuration and Ingress controller compatibility to assess impact.
